**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-05
**Title:** Meta title/description/keywords on Popular Truck [en] match the stored snapshot
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Compare the <title>, meta description and meta keywords on Popular Truck (en) with the stored snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx (Meta sheet) show expected vs actual so a real content/tag change can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

**Expected Result:**
The page title, meta description and meta keywords on Popular Truck (en) are unchanged from the snapshot.

**Steps:**
1. Open Popular Truck (en)
2. Read <title>, meta description and meta keywords
3. Compare with the stored snapshot
